# Original synthetic Easy runtime chart

`easy.chart` was authored for this project's tests. It is not transcribed from
Cream or another song and contains no audio.25notes use native frets0/1/2.
PPQ192; BPM120 until tick768,60 until1536,180 afterward. Independent start times
at tick0/768/1536/4608 are0/2/6/11.333333seconds before the2-second pre-roll.
One native release at tick384 lasts384ticks (one second); other releases are
one tick and are classified as short. All raw durations remain available.

Default Make builds this fixture into Imported Easy Test, labeled SYNTH/SILENT.
Selecting a private prepared header is explicit; no automatic incoming-song search.
